refs.label: the hero Сериализация: the base design, the parts layout and the approved clean finish

prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGES (attached in this order):
Image 1 = the hero Сериализация: the base design, the parts layout and the approved clean finish

STYLE BIBLE v2 (cyber datacenter): hand-drawn comic-book 2D game art, chunky readable cartoon shapes, cel shading with 2-3 hard-edged tones and grain; even medium-weight ink outline in very dark navy (#061018) around every object and major interior forms.
Palette: almost-black blue-teal bodies and metals (#071016, #0e1a22, #1a2a33, #2a3a44), matte, low saturation; light-emitting details (screens, LED strips, edge strips, indicator dots, power cores, cable ends) painted as FLAT pale cyan (#bff8ff) or pale mint (#c9fff0) shapes with a thin cyan (#00e5ff) border, no glow; warning details only in yellow (#ffd600) with black stripes; nothing warm, no brown, no beige, no orange metal.
Light: dim cool ambient from above, key from the upper left, lit faces only slightly lighter; the cyan details are the brightest areas; no cast shadows painted on the ground.
Strict top-down 3/4 view, camera about 50 degrees above the ground, orthographic, objects show their top and their front face.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no glow, no light rays, no cast shadows, no frame.

ASSET:
Use case: a SKIN for the hero of a top-down 3/4 survivors-like game set inside a dark cyberpunk datacenter: a character PART SHEET for cut-out rig animation.
Image 1 is the hero Сериализация (the base design and the exact parts layout): keep its silhouette, proportions and the U body, the two cubes with their small windows, the eyes, the limb design, the code panel with square marks on its front and the small scanner on each side, so the skin is clearly the same character and fits the same rig.
Skin: ВЗЛОМ — an aggressive armoured hacker variant: angular armour plating over the U with sharp chamfered edges and short swept-back fins on the cube tops; near-black graphite (#1d2126) armour with toxic neon green (#39ff88) edge lights; the cubes armoured in black with a neon green front plate; determined narrowed eyes with a confident grin; the limbs get sharp angular armour cuffs and the shoes become armoured boots with toxic neon green (#39ff88) soles; the code panel shows sharp neon green glyph squares, the side scanners become angular with green lenses.
Draw the character split into separate parts, front 3/4 view, all on one canvas:
- top row, centred: the BODY alone, with NO legs and NO arms (the hip and shoulder areas closed and complete), facing the viewer;
- bottom row, left to right, each part straight and vertical, complete: ONE LEG (hip at the top, ankle at the bottom, NO foot), ONE SHOE (side view, toe pointing right), ONE ARM (shoulder at the top, a mitten hand at the bottom).
Every part separate with very wide empty gaps (at least 80 px), nothing touching, overlapping or cut by the canvas edge.
Line and finish: crisp clean vector-like linework, one even thin dark navy outline (#0b1622) around every shape, smooth flat cel shading with one soft shadow tone and one highlight tone, NO grain, NO paint texture, NO noise, NO wobbly or blobby edges.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos other than the body shape itself, no ground, no shadow under the parts, no glow, transparent background.

Canvas: 1536x1024 px (3:2 landscape); if that exact size is unavailable, use the closest size with the same aspect ratio.

Background: fully transparent (real alpha channel, PNG) everywhere outside the ASSET, with clean anti-aliased edges; no ground or cast shadow beyond what the ASSET describes, no frame, no checkerboard pattern
